name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task 'Taking the key means you must open the door too' is a conditional rule: only if the key is taken must the door be opened. The hard Existence(door_open) adds an unconditional goal the task never states (the agent is not asked to open the door if it never takes the key). Remove it and keep only the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open), which correctly captures the 'if you take the key, the door must be opened too' rule.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The single hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) correctly captures 'Taking the key means you must open the door too' — if the key is ever taken (held), the door must be opened at some point, before or after. The event of the condition is not a goal, so no Existence is demanded; the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever the agent takes the key, the door must be opened too.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2

FINAL_STATES:

(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
